field.name: discountLimitPct
field.description: Max discount % allowed without the manager PIN (blank = no limit)

field.name: managerDiscountPin
field.description: PIN to authorise a discount above discountLimitPct

field.name: roundOffStep
field.description: Round payable DOWN to nearest this (e.g. 5); blank/0 = keep nearest-rupee auto round

field.name: completedDate
field.description: When the sale was closed/finalized (status set to PtCompleted)

field.name: isCredit
field.description: Y = completed credit (pay-later) sale, unpaid/partially paid

field.name: productTaxCode
field.description: Tax classification code (HSN, tax category, etc.)

field.name: manualPrice
field.description: Y = cashier hand-typed this unit price; quantity-break auto-pricing must NOT override it. Default N.

field.name: collectionSessionId
field.description: Drawer receiving this tender; nullable for legacy payments. May differ from the sale session for later credit collection.

field.name: itemsJson
field.description: JSON snapshot of cart items at hold time

moqui.service.job.ServiceJob.description: Void orphaned PtCreated POS carts on long-closed sessions (safety net)

field.name: dataFormat
field.description: Protocol format for weight data parsing

field.name: assignedWaiterId
field.description: ZE-KOT: waiter assigned to this table (set from the KOT screen)

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Fixed per-product price for this mode

zenith.erp.pos.PosSalesMode.description: Standard retail sales to walk-in customers (price + GST)
Wholesale sales at an explicit per-product price
Employee purchase at an explicit per-product price (price + GST)

field.name: requireCustomer
field.description: Y = block completing a sale in this mode unless a customer is attached to the bill.

field.name: minOrderAmount
field.description: Block completing a sale in this mode when the bill total is below this. Null/0 = no minimum.

field.name: thresholdQty
field.description: Auto-switch a RETAIL cart line to THIS mode's price once the line quantity reaches this value (per-product quantity break). Null/0 = off. Meaningful on a fixed mode such as Wholesale.

entity.description: Placeholder entity for POS scheduled-job seed data

moqui.service.job.ServiceJob.description: Near-real-time new-sale alerts for opted-in users (every 3 min)
